operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case + spaced identifiers: "POPULATION TYPE", "POPULATION COUNT", "PREVALENCE RATE", "PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE" need double-quoting; column lookup must be case-insensitive (DATE vs date, ID vs id).

claims FK declared as `references patients` / `references encounters` with NULL parent column -> pragma foreign_key_list parent col NULL, must resolve to same-name child column (PATIENT->patients.patient, ENCOUNTER->encounters.ID).
claims.ENCOUNTER samples are patient UUIDs, not encounter IDs: FK values are wrong in the original (parent_exists true but values don't match encounters.ID).

Text-stored dates in two formats: ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` in patients/encounters/careplans/conditions/immunizations/medications/observations/procedures/claims, but `M/D/YY` in allergies.START/STOP (declared TEXT so String fuzzer, not Date).
allergies.START/STOP are TEXT-typed dates with `3/11/95` style; ts_fuzzer=String so TS will emit random charset strings, not dates.
careplans has NO primary key (pk=[]) and ID is not unique (3673 distinct / 12125 rows); conditions/observations/procedures also pk-less.
Composite PKs: allergies(PATIENT,ENCOUNTER,CODE), immunizations(DATE,PATIENT,ENCOUNTER,CODE), medications(START,PATIENT,ENCOUNTER,CODE) -> composite-PK members get max_l0=30.
conditions.DESCRIPTION is an FK to all_prevalences.ITEM (TEXT->TEXT) but values are disorder names, not prevalence items: FK values don't match parent in original.
careplans.CODE declared REAL but holds integer-looking codes (53950000.0); observations.CODE declared TEXT holds `8302-2`; storage class contradicts declared type in both directions.
claims.DIAGNOSIS is 100% NULL (distinct 0, no samples) -> String sampler with empty elements, p:=1, all fresh random strings.
patients.passport has literal 'FALSE' string among X-prefixed values; marital only {S,M}; gender {F,M}; race 4 values; ethnicity 20 values -> tiny ENUM-like domains.
observations is the big table (78899 rows) plus encounters 20524, claims 20523; read_schema must sample by rowid, not load all.
operator_ts_expectations: Date fuzzer with template %Y-%m-%d for all DATE columns (birthdate, deathdate, encounters.DATE, careplans.START/STOP, conditions.START/STOP, immunizations.DATE, medications.START/STOP, observations.DATE, procedures.DATE, claims.BILLABLEPERIOD) -> plausible ISO dates, but range 1800..2100 if <2 distinct parsed.
allergies.START/STOP go through String fuzzer (declared TEXT) -> random a-zA-Z0-9() strings, never `M/D/YY`; queries comparing allergies.START to a date literal will miss.

String fuzzer for UUID columns (patient, ID, ENCOUNTER, PATIENT) -> random charset strings, not UUIDs; joins still work because FK fill copies parent values, but literal-pool UUIDs from train SQL are mixed in.

Number fuzzer for INTEGER/REAL codes (encounters.CODE, allergies.CODE, careplans.CODE, observations.VALUE, all_prevalences.OCCURRENCES) -> uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] then +-1/+-2 perturbation; huge implausible codes vs real 9-digit SNOMED codes -> FN on code-range predicates.
careplans.CODE REAL -> Number(scale=4) float draws like 1234.5678, but real values are integer-valued floats; equality predicates on CODE likely miss.
observations.CODE TEXT -> String fuzzer, real values `8302-2` (LOINC with dash); random strings won't match `CODE = '8302-2'` -> FN.

claims FK ENCOUNTER->encounters.ID: TS fills from encounters.ID (correct parent), but original claims.ENCOUNTER holds patient UUIDs; TS-generated joins claims-encounters will actually match more than original -> possible FP vs original semantics.

conditions.DESCRIPTION FK to all_prevalences.ITEM: TS copies all_prevalences.ITEM values (long drug strings) into conditions.DESCRIPTION, but real values are disorder names -> join conditions-all_prevalences on DESCRIPTION matches in TS but not original -> FP.
claims.DIAGNOSIS all-NULL: String sampler with no elements -> p=1, all fresh random strings; queries `DIAGNOSIS IS NULL` will return 0 rows in TS -> FN.

Tiny ENUM columns (marital S/M, gender F/M, race 4, ethnicity 20, prefix 3, suffix 3) -> String fuzzer mixes 5 original samples + pool literals + random charset strings; `gender='F'` may still hit but `race='white'` diluted.

pk-less tables (careplans, conditions, observations, procedures) get no PK dedup; unique-column dedup only if pragma index_list shows single-col unique (none here) -> duplicates allowed, ties present.
patients.patient PK String: 5 original UUID samples + pool literals + random strings; FK children copy these, so joins work but `patient LIKE '%-%'` style predicates may miss.
